At 01:12-01:13, as the waitress moves her mug against the man's mug and the man reaches out with his right hand, the two separate mugs merge into a single mug on the counter.

When the waitress walks around the counter and sits down next to the man at 01:20-01:26, her hands are empty and there is no mug on the counter in front of her stool. Upon cutting to the close-up at 01:27, she is holding a white coffee mug with both hands on the counter with no visible source.

At 01:50, two white coffee mugs are sitting on the counter in front of the waitress. At 01:51, she stands up with her left hand flat against the counter and picks up only the further mug with her right hand, yet as her body passes by at 01:51-01:52, the closer mug vanishes from the counter without being picked up.
